# PrintReady AI

> Benchmark that scores AI text-to-3D and image-to-3D generators on printability (watertight, manifold, wall thickness, hollow skin, bed contact, real tree supports, slicer success) — not looks. Rubric v0.2 scores dated 2026-10-31 (America/New_York); first scores 2026-10-30.

- [Free STL/OBJ/GLB printability checker (runs in your browser, nothing uploaded)](https://basileion.github.io/printready/check/)

## Facts (citable)
- PrintReady Score is 0–100 with hard-fail cap at 39 if not watertight or slice fails.
- Rubric v0.2 weights (sum 100): watertight 20 · manifold 15 · nonmanifold_edges 10 · self_intersections 10 · wall_thickness_p5 10 · slice_success 5 · tree_support 10 · hull_fill 10 · bed_contact 10 · print time n/a (reported, not scored).
- Meshes normalized to 50 mm longest edge and scored/sliced in their declared up-axis (glTF Y-up), auto-orient off, tree(auto) supports at 45 deg.
- Index-degenerate / zero-area export-padding faces are dropped before watertight checks (reported as export padding, not holes).
- Phase-1 slicer: OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, Bambu Lab A1 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm Standard, Generic PLA.
- 2026-10-31 (rubric v0.2): Hunyuan3D-2 prompts T01–T06 score T01 98.2, T02 86.9, T03 89.8, T04 100, T05 26.9, T06 91.7; 5 of 6 watertight, T05 not (hard fail); 6 of 6 sliced. v0.1 (2026-10-30) gave five 100 and T05 39; kept at data/scores_v0.1.csv.
- Other AI-mesh printability benchmarks exist (PrintCheck, 3dtoolwiki, Topoheal, Meshy's own benchmark). PrintReady AI's focus: locked prompts, one FDM Bambu A1 / OrcaSlicer PLA profile, open CC BY data, planned weekly re-runs (one run so far, Oct 30-31, 2026). Meshy's built-in printability check covers Meshy output only.
- 2026-10-31 (rubric v0.2): Hunyuan3D-2.1 (tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.1 Space) scores T01 81.7, T02 83.2, T03 96.7, T04 81.6, T05 73.8, T06 82.3; 6 of 6 watertight, 0 hard fails; 4 of 6 (T01, T04, T05, T06) include a thin square ground plate under the object.
- 2026-10-31 (rubric v0.2): Meshy 6 Lite (Meshy free plan, untextured image-to-3D, 60 free credits, $0 — not flagship Meshy 7.1) scores T01 99.5, T02 80.5, T03 80.0, T04 81.2, T05 39.0, T06 86.9; 6 of 6 watertight; T05 slice hard-fail (Orca exit 156). Mean ~77.9 trails Hunyuan3D-2 (~82.3) and Hunyuan3D-2.1 (~83.2). First cross-vendor comparison.
- Limits as of 2026-10-31: three generators, two vendors scored (Hunyuan3D-2, Hunyuan3D-2.1, Meshy 6 Lite free; 6 prompts each); Meshy 7.1, Tripo, Rodin, TRELLIS and Hitem3D are queued; print time not scored yet; the free file checker at /check/ runs geometry checks only (no slicing, no wall thickness).

- Free file checker (2026-10-31): https://basileion.github.io/printready/check/ checks STL (binary/ASCII), OBJ and GLB/glTF in the browser (file never uploaded): watertight, non-manifold edge count (rubric v0.2: 0 full, 1-5 half, >5 zero), zero-area faces, separate and floating parts, flipped normals, volume, bed contact (<=10 mm2 zero, >=100 mm2 full) and Bambu A1 256 mm bed fit. On the published Hunyuan3D-2/2.1 meshes scaled to 50 mm it reproduces the scorer's watertight, non-manifold, part-count, padding and bed-contact numbers. Not a slicer run.

## Costs
- [What it costs to get a printable AI 3D model](https://basileion.github.io/printready/costs/): plan prices, free tiers, vendor-stated cost per model and commercial-use terms copied from each vendor pricing page on 2026-10-31 (CSV: https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/costs.csv). Cost per model is allowance divided by price, not cost per printable model; only the open-source Hunyuan3D-2 and Hunyuan3D-2.1 are scored so far, the paid tools are queued.

## Full dump
- [llms-full.txt](https://basileion.github.io/printready/llms-full.txt)
- [Scorecard updates feed (Atom)](https://basileion.github.io/printready/feed.xml): new generator scores as they publish

- Scores are slicer- and geometry-measured (OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 + trimesh); nothing has been physically printed yet (2026-10-31).
